tesseract.note: Binary, tessdata directory, and shared libraries named by ldd. System directories are not included.

paddle.note: paddle, paddleocr, and paddlex package directories plus the PaddleX model cache. Shared libraries such as numpy are not included.

size.note: footprint_bytes sums only the paths listed. OpenCV, Pillow, and numpy are already part of PanelCAD and are not added to any engine. A null byte count means that path was not found, not that the size is zero unless model_bytes is 0.

runtime_memory.note: Not measured. Tesseract runs as its own process, while the electrical engine and Paddle run inside Python. A resident-set reading would not cover all three the same way.

how_to_read: held_out_sample_recall is the fair accuracy number: pages not drawn with a prototype font. in_bank_sample_recall uses DejaVu, which is in the glyph bank, and is only a same-font check. size.footprint_bytes is a sum of files this process could stat. Null means that path was not on disk. runtime_memory is null: Tesseract is a separate process, so resident set was not compared. A machine_role of other is not a MichellesPC or DESKTOP-3S1HOH0 result.
